definition: Vladimir Naumovich Vapnik (Russian: Владимир Наумович Вапник; born 6 December 1936) is a statistician, researcher, and academic.
details: Developed Statistical Learning Theory, Vapnik-Chervonenkis (VC) dimension, and the Support Vector Machine algorithm. He is one of the main developers of the Vapnik–Chervonenkis theory of statistical learning and the co-inventor of the support-vector machine method and support-vector clustering algorithms.
